_about: Visual style menu. Each style = 2 fonts max (one bold, one contrasting), a palette, an FFmpeg grade, and caption CSS. Fonts come from npm @fontsource packages (pkg + file) so renders work offline; 'google' is the Google Fonts family string used only for HTML previews (storyboard, style menu).

sleepy-diary.name: Sleepy Diary
sleepy-diary.mood: Cozy, deadpan, warm. Handwritten notes over soft matte footage.
sleepy-diary.best_for: Sleepy or lazy pets, 'how to' routines, slow cute moments
sleepy-diary.pacing: Calm hook, 0.7-0.9s montage cuts, long quiet holds at the end
sleepy-diary.label_css: color: var(--dark); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .07em; font-family: var(--bold); font-weight: 800; text-shadow: 0 0 3px rgba(255,237,172,1), 0 0 12px rgba(255,237,172,.95), 0 0 26px rgba(255,237,172,.8), 0 0 48px rgba(255,237,172,.55);
sleepy-diary.line_css: color: var(--light); font-family: var(--accent); font-weight: 700; text-shadow: 0 4px 22px rgba(62,39,35,.6), 0 1px 3px rgba(62,39,35,.5);

editorial-script.name: Editorial Script
editorial-script.mood: Clean, bright, boutique. A big script word over neutral, airy footage.
editorial-script.best_for: Recipes, product or treat prep, gifts, aesthetic home moments
editorial-script.pacing: Title held across 3-4 cuts, 0.4-0.8s cuts on hand actions, 1.5s holds at the end
editorial-script.label_css: color: var(--light); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .22em; font-family: var(--bold); font-weight: 600; font-size: .62em; text-shadow: 0 1px 10px rgba(0,0,0,.45);
editorial-script.line_css: color: var(--light); font-family: var(--accent); font-weight: 400; text-shadow: 0 2px 14px rgba(0,0,0,.45);

soft-film.name: Soft Film
soft-film.mood: Nostalgic, cinematic. Teal shadows, orange fur, faded blacks.
soft-film.best_for: Firsts (first rain, first walk), outdoor moments, emotional stories
soft-film.pacing: Slower: 1-2s shots, gentle push-ins, one line of text per beat
soft-film.label_css: color: var(--dark); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .08em; font-family: var(--bold); font-weight: 800; text-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(246,231,200,.9), 0 0 30px rgba(246,231,200,.6);
soft-film.line_css: color: var(--light); font-family: var(--accent); font-style: italic; font-weight: 600; text-shadow: 0 3px 18px rgba(47,42,38,.65);

bold-meme.name: Bold Meme
bold-meme.mood: Loud and punchy. Big outlined captions, saturated color, fast cuts.
bold-meme.best_for: Zoomies, chaos, fails, reactions, anything with a punchline
bold-meme.pacing: Fast: 0.3-0.6s cuts, speed ramps, a hard stop before the punchline
bold-meme.label_css: color: var(--accent-c); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .03em; font-family: var(--bold); font-weight: 400; -webkit-text-stroke: 3px #111; paint-order: stroke fill;
bold-meme.line_css: color: var(--light); font-family: var(--accent); font-weight: 400; -webkit-text-stroke: 4px #111; paint-order: stroke fill; text-shadow: 0 6px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.35);

quiet-mono.name: Quiet Mono
quiet-mono.mood: Minimal and calm. Small lowercase type, cool desaturated footage, lots of air.
quiet-mono.best_for: Daily routines, ASMR, morning or night rituals, 'a day with' diaries
quiet-mono.pacing: Even 1-1.5s cuts, no speed ramps, timestamps or counters as labels
quiet-mono.label_css: color: var(--accent-c); text-transform: lowercase; letter-spacing: .12em; font-family: var(--accent); font-weight: 400; font-size: .7em; text-shadow: 0 1px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.4);
quiet-mono.line_css: color: var(--light); text-transform: lowercase; font-family: var(--bold); font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -.01em; text-shadow: 0 2px 14px rgba(0,0,0,.4);

pastel-pop.name: Pastel Pop
pastel-pop.mood: Sweet, bright and bubbly. Rounded type on candy colors.
pastel-pop.best_for: Kittens and puppies, birthdays, toys, playful 'meet my pet' intros
pastel-pop.pacing: Bouncy: 0.5-0.8s cuts, pop-in text, quick zoom punches
pastel-pop.label_css: color: var(--light); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .06em; font-family: var(--bold); font-weight: 600; text-shadow: 0 0 0 transparent, 0 4px 0 var(--accent-c), 0 6px 18px rgba(122,62,101,.45);
pastel-pop.line_css: color: var(--light); font-family: var(--accent); font-weight: 700; text-shadow: 0 3px 0 var(--dark), 0 6px 20px rgba(122,62,101,.5);
